page.notes: Left margin also shows faint show-through from the reverse page, ignored. The reading "Nymphææ" at the end of the Nymphæa line is doubtful. The Ruta/Pulegium and Psyllium/Obsoniorum endings are ligature-like hooks printed as plain endings; "Pulegiū" is read with a macron. The catchword "sica" is partly obscured and read from the right-bottom corner. The left-margin notes are italic and their hyphens are printed.
